rule: Each case is one panel of the gallery's association scatter demo in one view. Its rows are the rows the chart drew in that panel: one per participant, made by the core's frame from the vendored synthetic study with the demo page’s own settings. On a logarithmic axis the chart hands R the base-10 logarithm of x or y, and the R script takes the same logarithm of these rows.
